answer: Every agent ID must answer a memory-hard puzzle within two seconds, and the Nebula scheduler sends these checks to all IDs at the same random moment. Each answer needs 4 GB of RAM held live, so one box can't forge replies for ten IDs at once. A farm needs a separate machine for each fake, and its hardware bill rises with every one it adds. A late or missing answer zeroes that ID's pearl payout for the epoch. IDs whose replies share timing jitter get flagged as a group.
